messages:
Maya: Heads up — planning to toggle feature flag `new-rerank` OFF in prod eu-west during the midnight patch window (00:30–01:00 UTC) to force the single-model path while we backfill KV caches. Will do staged cohorts. Any objections?
Sam: +1 from infra, what's the cohort plan?
Maya: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over ~20m intervals, sticky sessions retained. If p95 latency >450ms or error rate increases >0.8% we pause/rollback.
Leo: Recommend pinning the rerank model to v2.3.1 for the path to avoid mismatch. I'll push the routing pin now.
Maya: Command I'll run:

```
rbctl ff set new-rerank --env=prod --region=eu-west --state=off --cohorts=10,30,100 --sticky=true --reason "backfill-kv"
```

Maya: Also plan a canary hold for the first cohort and manual approval to proceed.
deploy-bot: backfill job queued: bf-20260320-01. ETA 12m. will post status updates.
Anya: Oncall here — I'll monitor SLOs and traces. Alerts: error_rate >0.8% or p95 >450ms.
Sam: Define rollback runbook: 1) rbctl ff set new-rerank --state=on 2) unpin routing 3) cancel backfill bf-20260320-01 and drain. Who owns?
Leo: I'll own rollback and runbook steps are in /runbooks/ff-backfill.md. I'll also pre-stage revert PR for routing-pin.
Maya: I'll draft release-note snippet for #release-notes after success: "Temporarily disabled new-rerank in eu-west for KV cache backfill; monitored performance during window." 
oncall-bot: Alert rule eu-west-ff-backfill created -> channel #eng-oncall
Maya: Starting toggle at 00:32 UTC. Status updates every 10m. :rocket:
Sam: Thanks — please ping if we hit any SLO blips. :thumbsup:
